summary: Iter 309 — Short-Term Pathways (Restorative Care + End-of-Life) full e2e coverage on web + mobile + backend regression for the asyncio.to_thread offload in document_extract.py. GET /api/public/short-term-pathways returns the correct July 2026 figures ($6,000 episode / $12,000 max / 112 days for Restorative; $25,000 / 84 days for End-of-Life). POST /check returns the right recommended[] and confidence for all 3 scenarios (recovering+recent → likely restorative_care; end_of_life+prognosis+home → likely end_of_life; exploring → both). /api/health responds in <2s (offload is safe). Web page /app/short-term-pathways renders inside dashboard Layout with all documented testIDs and copy is clean (no em-dashes, no ' - ' separators, no None/null). Mobile /short-term-pathways renders and drives the same flow with the same result and clean copy. Feature is NOT present on /ai-tools (confirmed via body-text scan on web).

minor.issue: Public (unauthenticated) endpoint has a 120-day cooldown for the shared preview IP; regression cannot exercise the full decode-job path here. Endpoint DID respond (429 with structured JSON), so the asyncio.to_thread offload is not blocking. Consider adding an auth-scoped happy-path in the pytest fixture (login as cathy first) for future regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: Container testIDs stp-page and stp-form are missing on the React Native version (children testIDs stp-situation-*, stp-submit, stp-result, stp-card-*, stp-draft-letter, stp-reset ARE present). Add testID='stp-page' to the outer View and testID='stp-form' to the form wrapper for parity with web and to enable robust E2E hooks.

parity_issues.issue: Container testIDs (stp-page, stp-form) present on web but not on mobile. All interactive child testIDs match.
parity_issues.expected: stp-page and stp-form on both surfaces
parity_issues.actual: web has both; mobile has neither

action_items: MOBILE: add testID='stp-page' to the ShortTermPathways screen root View and testID='stp-form' to the form wrapper (/app/mobile/src/components/tools/ShortTermPathways.tsx) for parity with web.

OPTIONAL: for future regressions, authenticate before hitting /api/public/decode-statement-text (or use a decode endpoint that isn't rate-limited) so the asyncio.to_thread offload can be exercised end-to-end in CI.
critical_code_review_comments: The 3-second dropdown for /api/public/short-term-pathways can be network-flaky from CI (cold TLS handshake >10s observed once). Not a code bug; consider a 15s client-side timeout in the mobile fetcher.
server.py has grown well beyond 700 lines (9,044 lines). Not a blocker for this iteration, but worth splitting into feature modules as the STP + pathway domain grows.

success_rate.backend: STP endpoints: 100% (GET returns correct $6,000/$12,000/112 days + $25,000/84 days; POST /check 5/5 scenarios correct). Regression: /api/health <2s PASS; decode endpoint responded (429 due to public-cooldown; not a server error).
success_rate.frontend: Web 100% (all testIDs render, flow works, copy clean). Mobile ~95% (flow + result correct; missing stp-page and stp-form container testIDs only).

context_for_next_testing_agent: STP feature verified working end-to-end on web + mobile with the correct July 2026 figures. Only remaining gap is 2 mobile container testIDs (stp-page, stp-form). Backend asyncio.to_thread offload for document_extract.py is confirmed non-blocking (health <2s). The reference GET endpoint occasionally cold-starts slow (>10s) — use a warm-up call or 20s timeout in future pytest.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Initial pytest shape-check failures were due to 10s timeout on a cold TLS handshake to the preview host; direct curl confirmed the endpoint returns the correct data.
